race.description: Elgin Valley Farms Qlder Open Hcp
race.comment: CUNNAMULLA FELLA (3) is in terrific touch this campaign, having won here over the mile two starts ago before covering ground on heavy going and still running third behind the impressive Brindavan. Yet to prove himself over this trip but the low draw will give him a good look. LIBERTY PARK (9) has to rebound from his last run here but it was almost too bad to be true. His two wins to kick off the prep however were good, so he's every chance of bouncing back under the featherweight. JENNI MOREESE (4) only warmed late last week at Doomben behind the well-supported Atmosphere. Returns to a track she absolutely relishes third-up on the quick turnaround and can play a major role. YET HE MOVES (6) continues to leave himself with too much to do but has a powerful turn off foot on his day. Watch for him launching late if the pace is genuine. FAWKNER PARK (1) shoulders peaks that would blow this lot out of the water but that's a fair while ago. There might've been signs of life last start.
